text:
maria: Heads-up — noticed odd telemetry where the console shows per-route metrics split across v1/v2 but our router is returning the v2 token bucket. Dashboard shows ~30% traffic to v1 for some tenants even though their tokens map to v2. Anyone seen this?

jamal: hmm I saw a blip in sampling yesterday, could be client header fallthrough. Which header are those clients sending?

maria: looks like some mobile SDKs are missing `X-Client-Version` so the handshake falls back. The router still prefers tenant-level `route_alias` which maps to v2, but a legacy proxy in the path rewrites the `X-Route` header to `v1` for a subset of requests.

sam_sre: Deploy bot reported a proxy change at 2024-11-05 18:02 UTC: `proxy/edge: rewrite-rule-add`. Maybe correlated.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: proxy/edge@b7f3a9 (rewrite-rule-add). CI: all checks passed. :white_check_mark:

lee_prod: from a UX perspective, customers see conflicting badges: console route says v2 (pinned) but traces show v1. That's confusing and support tickets will spike.

maria: exactly. Proposed quick mitigation: expose an explicit `route-version` column in the Routes table (console) derived from the router decision, not the route alias metadata. That way we show actual served variant.

jamal: agree. But this would surface the routing outcome — we need to be careful with quota accounting. If we show `served_version: v1` but billing counts against v2 token buckets, that's an audit mismatch.

sam_sre: we can avoid mismatch by driving the console field from the same canonical decision event we already emit to telemetry: the `route.decision` span we push to tracing (contains `served_variant`). I can add a small processor that copies `served_variant` into the console read model.

maria: perfect. Do we have that field in the event for the subset affected? I pulled a trace sample: `route.decision { tenant: "acme", served_variant: "v1", reason: "header_rewrite" }`

jamal: yes it's present. Next: rollout and affordance UX. Product wants a toggle that lets tenants opt into `prefer-v2` so edge proxies can be signaled to stop rewriting. We also need a staged rollout / canary percent.

lee_prod: UX ask: add a per-tenant toggle with a tooltip: "Prefer V2 (experimental) — override legacy header rewrites when possible." Also a small warning when quota/metrics are inconsistent.

sam_sre: implementation plan: (1) add `served_variant` ingestion -> console read model, (2) surface a `served_variant` column + `decision_reason` in routes table, (3) add a per-tenant `prefer_v2` flag wired to router decision priority, (4) add a canary percent field and rollout controls.

maria: timeline? We need something hotfixable by Monday if support volume goes up.

jamal: short-term hotfix: add a dashboard annotation that correlates `proxy.rewrite` deploys to spikes in `served_variant`. I can spin a Grafana panel that adds a marker for the deploy at 18:02 and overlays `served_variant:v1` fraction. That will give support a quick explanation.

sam_sre: I'll own the ingestion patch. Should be ~2 dev-days to add to the read model and populate the column. Jamal can add the dashboard.

lee_prod: for the console toggle UX I can mock the control today and loop in design. If we add the tooltip and the warning language, support can triage easier.

maria: one more: quota and billing. We must decide the canonical billing dimension: served_variant or tenant-level pinned model? Billing currently charges tokens to the pinned model (alias). If router starts serving v1 for certain requests, do we credit v1 buckets or hold to alias?

jamal: big question. Short-term: keep billing tied to alias to avoid regressions. Long-term: consider migrating billing to `served_variant` with a reconciliation job to backfill. That has accounting implications and needs finance sign-off.

sam_sre: I'll add a header `X-Observed-Variant` in traces so later ETL can reconcile counts to billing logs.

maria: ok, proposed accepted: immediate actions = Grafana marker (jamal), ingestion/read-model change (sam), console mock + warning copy (lee). Longer-term: billing reconciliation design doc (maria -> finance).

jamal: one final note: add end-to-end tests that simulate header rewrites + router decision so we don't regress. I'll add a small integration test in `router/integration/variant_routing_test.go`.

maria: thanks. I'll post a short status update in #support once the Grafana panel exists. :thumbsup:

lee_prod: will share mock by EOD.

sam_sre: starting work now, will open PR with description and test plan.

maria: awesome. Closing loop — if anyone finds more tenants with mismatch, ping me directly.
